tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, REST APIs | 5+ yrs E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, microservices and performance-tuned SQL. Proven record in PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, and techno-functional analysis translating business needs into robust e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Developer SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Leuchtmehr’s ambition to build a globally used SAP Commerce platform with modern web components. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and large-scale integrations that align perfectly with your technical vision.

bullets.label: Technical Design
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend components on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, applying Java, Spring and design patterns to meet complex e-commerce requirements.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST services and Spring-Boot micro-services for headless commerce, ensuring robust, scalable APIs for internal and third-party consumption.

bullets.label: Integration & API
bullets.text: I engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and API migrations that synchronized product data across SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, and led code reviews to improve code quality and performance.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Developer SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_de.hook: Die ambitionierte Ausrichtung von Leuchtmehr, eine international eingesetzte SAP-Commerce-Plattform mit modernen Web-Komponenten zu realisieren, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der End-to-End-Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Spring, REST/OCC-APIs und komplexen Integrationen mit, die exakt zu Ihren Anforderungen passen.

bullets.label: Technisches Design
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Komponenten auf SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 konzipiert und implementiert, wobei ich Java, Spring und bewährte Design-Patterns eingesetzt habe, um komplexe E-Commerce-Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

bullets.label: Java- & Spring-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und stellte OCC-REST-Services sowie Spring-Boot-Micro-Services für Headless-Commerce bereit und gewährleistete robuste, skalierbare APIs für interne und externe Nutzer.

bullets.label: Integration & API
bullets.text: Ich konzipierte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) und API-Migrationen, die Produktdaten über SAP ERP und MDM-Systeme synchronisieren.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps
bullets.text: Ich führte CI/CD-Deployments auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) mit Jenkins, Docker und Kubernetes durch und leitete Code-Reviews zur Steigerung von Code-Qualität und Performance.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Ihrem Team zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Leuchtmehr’s focus on delivering a high-performance, globally scalable SAP Commerce Cloud platform aligns with my passion for building robust e-commerce solutions. The opportunity to work on complex integrations with SAP S/4HANA and BTP, while shaping architectural standards and mentoring international teams, matches my experience and career goals. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce expertise to drive Leuchtmehr’s growth and innovation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Leuchtmehr build a world-class, scalable e-commerce platform, driving innovation through robust integrations and modern web technologies.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about Leuchtmehr’s global e-commerce vision and would love to discuss how my Java, Spring and integration experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Developer SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Developer SAP Commerce Cloud position at Leuchtmehr GmbH. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring and large-scale integrations, I am confident I can contribute to your platform’s success. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
